headline: Cricket 07
title: Cricket 07 Facts | EA Century Stick Batting | Classic Games
video_script: Cricket 07 is an EA Sports cricket game from twenty oh six, made by HB Studios and EA Canada for PC and PlayStation two. Its big idea was the Century Stick. Instead of face buttons, you bat with both analog sticks. One stick picks front foot or back foot, and the other sets timing, direction and power. England's Andrew Flintoff was on the European cover. Did you play it in your cyber cafe? Comment below!
description: Cricket 07 by HB Studios and EA Canada, published by EA Sports in 2006, introduced the Century Stick batting control. Sources: Wikipedia, GameSpot and Hexus reviews.
joke: The only thing harder than the bowling was getting a turn on the family computer.
